manifest.description: Sends large files as a password-protected link from your Nextcloud.
manifest.tooltip: Send large files as a password-protected link from your Nextcloud.
manifest.readTooltip: Shows whether your CloudShare links were downloaded and how the password went out – for this message and all valid shares.

addin.help.heading: Help
addin.help.intro: CloudShare sends large files securely: the file is stored in your Nextcloud and the recipients get a link to download it. The password comes separately – automatically, after you have sent the message.
addin.help.start.title: Getting started (only once)
addin.help.start.1: Open a new message and click “CloudShare” in the ribbon.
addin.help.start.2: Click “Connect to Nextcloud”. The sign-in opens in the browser – usually without typing anything.
addin.help.files.title: Sending large files
addin.help.files.1: Write your message as usual and attach the file – or drag the file onto the CloudShare pane.
addin.help.files.2: Large attachments are already ticked. Tick the files that should go out as a link.
addin.help.files.4: Click “Insert file as link” at the bottom. The attachment is replaced by a download link.
addin.help.files.5: Send the message. Shortly afterwards the recipients get the password in a separate message.
addin.help.files.note: You neither have to note down the password nor send it yourself.
addin.help.password.title: Password and how it is sent
addin.help.password.random: “Random password”: CloudShare creates a secure password that is easy to read out. This is almost always the right choice.
addin.help.password.own: “Own password”: if you have already agreed on a password with the recipients.
addin.help.password.none: “No password”: anyone who knows the link can download the file. Only for documents that may be public anyway.
addin.help.password.privacy: Always send personal or confidential data with a password.
addin.help.password.channel: Under “Send the password to” you choose who gets the password: the recipients of the message, another email address or – if set up – a phone number (mobile or landline) by text message. With a text message, link and password arrive on separate ways; that is the most secure.
addin.help.password.validity: Under “Validity” you set how long the link works (with a password at most 30 days) and how long and how often the password can be fetched. The defaults usually fit.
addin.help.message.title: Confidential message
addin.help.message.text: For short confidential details such as access data: choose “Message” at the top, write the text and click “Insert confidential message”. The text is not in the email. The recipients open it through a link with the password; it is deleted when it expires.
addin.help.request.title: Receiving files from others
addin.help.request.text: Choose “Request” at the top and click “Insert upload link”. The recipients – for example citizens or partners – can upload files to you through it, very large ones too. The files end up in your Nextcloud. “My shares” shows how many have arrived; depending on the setup you also get an email as soon as new files are there.
addin.help.shares.title: Overview: My shares
addin.help.shares.text: Under “My shares” you see all your valid links: how long they last, whether the file was downloaded and how the password was sent. When you open a sent message and click “CloudShare” there, “Message” shows the links of that message and “My shares” all of them. The icons next to the name:
addin.help.shares.password: Password – shows the password and sends it again, by email or text message (only for links with a password, until they expire).
addin.help.shares.insert: Insert – inserts the file as a new link into the message you are writing (only while writing a message).
addin.help.shares.revoke: Revoke – blocks the link at once, for example if it went to the wrong person. Click a second time to confirm (“Sure?”).
addin.help.shares.refresh: Refresh – at the top next to the “?”: reloads the list. This happens by itself when you open the tab and when you come back to the pane.
addin.help.shares.account: At the very bottom you see your Nextcloud account and its free space; you can also disconnect there.
addin.help.shares.notices: Depending on the setup you also get an email as soon as a file has been downloaded for the first time or new files have arrived through an upload link. Whether you get these notifications is up to you in the settings.
addin.help.settings.title: Settings
addin.help.settings.open: The gear at the very bottom next to your Nextcloud account opens your personal settings. They apply to you on every computer.
addin.help.settings.channels: Send the password to: which ways you are offered when inserting and which one is already selected for a new message.
addin.help.settings.notices: Notifications: whether you get an email when a file was downloaded, when files arrived through an upload link or when a text message with the password could not be delivered.
addin.help.settings.language: Language: as in Outlook or a fixed language for CloudShare.
addin.help.settings.signature: Signature: shown below the inserted link. Copy your Outlook signature into it – as text or formatted. Without an own signature, your organisation's applies.
addin.help.settings.fixed: What your organisation decides – for example which countries text messages may go to and which phone numbers are blocked – cannot be changed here. “Reset” brings back your organisation's defaults.
addin.help.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
addin.help.faq.noPassword.q: The recipients did not get a password.
addin.help.faq.noPassword.a: Open “My shares”, click the key icon (“Password”) at the link and send it again. Also ask the recipients to look in their spam folder.
addin.help.faq.expired.a: Expired links are no longer listed in “My shares”. Attach the file again and insert it as a link – this creates a new link with a new password.
addin.help.faq.wrong.q: I sent the link to the wrong person.
addin.help.faq.wrong.a: Click the “Revoke” icon (crossed-out circle) at the link in “My shares” and confirm with “Sure?”. After that nobody can download the file any more.
addin.help.faq.unsent.q: A link in “My shares” says “Not sent”.
addin.help.faq.unsent.a: The message with this link has not been sent yet – for example because you discarded the draft. So the password has not been sent either. If you still send the message, everything is fine. Otherwise CloudShare revokes the link itself after 7 days; the “Revoke” icon (crossed-out circle) does it right away.
addin.help.faq.sms.q: I received the message “Text message not sent” or “Text message not delivered”.
addin.help.faq.sms.a: The password was then not sent – not any other way either. Send it again with the key icon (“Password”), for example to a corrected number.
addin.help.faq.who.a: Only those who have the link and the password. The files are stored in your Nextcloud; once the link has expired they can no longer be downloaded.
addin.help.faq.send.q: Outlook points me to CloudShare when sending.
addin.help.faq.send.a: The message contains large attachments. Open CloudShare and insert the files as a link. Whether you may also send the message as it is depends on your organisation.
addin.help.support: If you have questions or problems, please contact your IT support.
